info.name: Onchain Intern Certificate API Tests
info.description:
Complete API test suite for the Onchain Intern Certificate project

Recommended Order of Operations:

1. Company Setup (Company Tests):
   - Create company
   - Get/update company details

2. Employee Management (Employee Tests):
   - Add employees
   - Confirm employee accounts
   - Update employee details/status

3. Certificate Templates (Certificate Tests):
   - Create certificate templates
   - Get/update templates

4. Certificate Operations (Certificate Tests):
   - Issue certificates using templates
   - Verify certificates
   - Get/manage certificates

5. Award Management (Award Tests):
   - Create award types
   - Update award types
   - Mint award NFTs

Note: Follow this order as many operations depend on the existence of entities created in previous steps.
